name: Matt Kondraki
source: Abrasive and arrogant, Kondraki is the captain of the fencing team, and is a spoiled, rich jerk who always gets what he wants. Despite his abusive attitude, he has a lot of 'henchmen' and many girls compete for his attention. (Student Number: 1069-2117)
